title: Unlocking Bias Detection: Leveraging Transformer-Based Models for Content Analysis
findings: The proposed CBDT model demonstrated the highest performance in identifying biased tokens related to religion, achieving a macro-averaged F1-score of 82.56%, outperforming other models like GPT-3.5 (80.45%) and RoBERTa (78.01%).
